def water_collection(x, y, heights):
    # Create a 2D list to store the maximum water height that can be trapped in each cell
    water_trapped = [[0] * x for _ in range(y)]
    
    # Fill the first and last rows
    for i in range(x):
        water_trapped[0][i] = heights[0][i]
        water_trapped[y - 1][i] = heights[y - 1][i]
    
    # Fill the first and last columns
    for i in range(y):
        water_trapped[i][0] = heights[i][0]
        water_trapped[i][x - 1] = heights[i][x - 1]
    
    # Process the inner cells
    for i in range(1, y - 1):
        for j in range(1, x - 1):
            water_trapped[i][j] = max(heights[i][j], min(water_trapped[i - 1][j], water_trapped[i + 1][j], water_trapped[i][j - 1], water_trapped[i][j + 1]))
    
    # Calculate the total area where water can be trapped
    total_water_trapped = 0
    for i in range(y):
        for j in range(x):
            total_water_trapped += water_trapped[i][j] - heights[i][j]
    
    return total_water_trapped
